weeks.bio:
NEW DATE, WEDS NOV 25TH Faren Rajkumar AKA Mother Void is a nomadic musician & muse of West Indian ancestry, currently based in the PNW. she celebrates her culture & the Matriarchy through musical expression and commanding the dancefloor.

Mother Void is a classically trained violinist offering DJ sets w/ live violin, acoustic instrumentals, and private instruction. she has been playing violin for over 25 years, and recently developed mixing skills to combine electronic and acoustic sounds for dance.

as a dance journey facilitator/DJ, Mother Void invites bodies to contemplate their inner dark matter and creation center, conjure movement medicine and experience the sacred sensations of sound, vibration, motion, touch and stillness. she is an expert at creating complete dance arc journeys that can take you through the five rhythms, induce powerful awakening & release of suppressed sensual energy, or inspire play with others on the dance floor.
weeks.name: Dj MotherVoid
weeks.somaticBlurb:
Bradley Pizzimenti is a dancer and facilitator based in Central Oregon. His background spans contact improvisation, ecstatic dance, and tango, including a year of intensive study in Buenos Aires. He has taught and facilitated across these forms and helped organize the Bend Weekly Contact Jam. He’s drawn to slowness, the fluid exchange of leading and following, and the process of arriving at movement together. His approach invites curiosity, attentive listening, and play, with room to settle, sense what’s emerging, and let a shared dance take shape in its own time.

Our weekly eDance offers a facilitated movement experience called Soma Lab.
It’s included in the regular cost of entry.
Each Week:
7-7:45pm Soma Lab
8-10pm Ecstatic Dance
All together $22-18 Sliding Scale Payment

weeks.bio:
Apukuna is known for creating immersive, genre-blending journeys that ignite dance floors and
ecstatic dances, guide ambient sound journeys, and deepen breathwork sessions.
His approach is distinctly live and improvisational. Through looping, live remixing, vocals, and
percussion, he shapes each set in real time—blurring the line between DJ and live performance.
Rooted in both global and contemporary sounds, Apukuna artfully merges heart-centered
frequencies with soul-shaking movement. He describes his sonic creations as “a movement, a
meditation, and a prayer for an awakening heart”.
Apukuna is a regular contributor to ecstatic dances across Canada and the USA and has
performed and facilitated at gatherings internationally, including BOOM Festival (Portugal),
Dreamersland (Poland), Ecstatic Dance Festival (Cyprus), Connexion Extatique (Canada), Rise
Wellness Festival (Canada), Beyond Music & Arts Festival (Turkey), Wicked Woods Music
Festival (Canada), Sonic Springs (Canada) and Burning Man (USA).
On SoundCloud, his mixes attract a global following. His “Return of the Bird Tribes” journey is a
steady favorite along with mixes produced for Jumpsuit Records, NUMA, Baikal Nomads,
Echoes from Venus, Ritmos del Sur and Cosmovision Records
weeks.name: Dj Apukuna

weeks.shortDescription: A gift of passion and professionalism Dj Qoi travels the world collecting inspirations and slices of the universal knowledge pie that sweeten her essence and find themselves baked into her sets.
weeks.bio: Qoi is a dynamic force in the electronic music scene-a DJ, producer, and vocalist weaving deep, hypnotic rhythms with ethereal, soul-stirring vocals. Her sets are an enchanting fusion of organic and electronic elements, moving effortlessly between deep bass primal beats, melodic textures, and evocative, healing vocals. Qoi’s music is a journey—one that awakens the senses and invites full-bodied movement.With a deep-rooted passion for bass music, ecstatic dance and global sounds, Qoi channels the sacred and the cinematic, creating dance floors that feel both primal and transcendent. She curates every set as a ritual, guiding listeners through deep basslines, soaring melodies, and hypnotic soundscapes designed to elevate the mind, body, and spirit.
weeks.name: Dj Qoi

weeks.shortDescription: an Ecstatic dance journey which saunters in sounds of all tempos and temperatures. Rising from downtempo and global fusion through bass, trap and riddim into house, trance and baile funk.
weeks.bio: Niz Dass (Nate Mladenovic) is a DJ based in Seattle. DJing for over 20 years, he draws inspiration from his own explorations with dance, beginning in the nightclubs of Madrid, discovering ecstatic dance in Los Angeles, and learning the style of Brazilian Zouk in Seattle. A synesthete who sees color in music, he creates soundscapes that reflect the world as it appears. He is a regular for Seattle Ecstatica dance events, including Bloom Dance and Moon Dance.
weeks.name: Dj Niz Dass
